ko.title: [농업 101 #1] 하루에 세 번 사용하는 가장 오래된 기술

segments.src: > Agriculture is the applied science of managing living systems — plants, animals, soil, and microbes — to produce food, fiber, and fuel, and today it borrows as much from data science as from botany.
segments.tr: > 농업은 생명 체계(식물, 동물, 토양, 미생물)를 관리하여 식량, 섬유, 연료를 생산하는 응용 과학이며, 오늘날에는 식물학만큼이나 데이터 과학을 차용한다.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## 오늘의 개념

segments.src: Most people picture agriculture as a job.
segments.tr: 대부분의 사람들은 농업을 하나의 직업으로 생각한다.

segments.src: Academically, it's a **discipline** — one of the oldest organized bodies of applied knowledge we have.
segments.tr: 학문적으로는 **학문 분야**이다 — 우리가 가진 가장 오래되고 체계적인 응용 지식 분야 중 하나다.

segments.src: Here's the shortest useful definition: **agriculture is the deliberate management of biological systems to produce things humans need.** Every word carries weight.
segments.tr: 가장 짧고 유용한 정의를 제시하자면: **농업은 인간이 필요한 것을 생산하기 위해 생물 체계를 의도적으로 관리하는 것이다.** 한 단어 한 단어가 중요하다.

segments.src: *Deliberate* separates it from foraging.
segments.tr: *의도적인* 관리는 농업을 채집과 구분한다.

segments.src: *Biological systems* means you're working with organisms that grow, reproduce, get sick, and die on their own schedule.
segments.tr: *생물 체계*란 스스로의 일정에 따라 자라고, 번식하고, 병들고, 죽는 생물체와 함께 일한다는 뜻이다.

segments.src: *Manage* means you don't control them — you nudge them.
segments.tr: *관리한다*는 것은 그들을 통제하지 않는다는 뜻 — 당신은 그들을 조정할 뿐이다.

segments.src: That last point is the whole reason agriculture became a science instead of a craft.
segments.tr: 이 마지막 점이 농업이 공예가 아니라 과학이 된 전체 이유다.

segments.src: A civil engineer specifying a steel beam knows the yield strength.
segments.tr: 토목 기사가 강철 보를 설계할 때는 항복 강도를 안다.

segments.src: A farmer planting corn is negotiating with weather, soil chemistry, insect populations, and a genome — none of which sends a spec sheet.
segments.tr: 옥수수를 심는 농부는 날씨, 토양 화학, 곤충 개체군, 유전체와 협상한다 — 이 중 누구도 명세서를 보내지 않는다.

segments.src: **A quick history, in four moves:**
segments.tr: **빠르게 보는 역사, 4단계로:**

segments.src: 1. **Domestication (~10,000 BCE).** Humans in several regions independently began selecting and replanting favorable seeds. This wasn't invention so much as a slow feedback loop. Wheat and barley in the Fertile Crescent, rice in China, maize in Mesoamerica, potatoes in the Andes. Surplus food made cities possible.
segments.tr: 1. **가축화 (~기원전 10,000년).** 여러 지역의 인간들은 독립적으로 유리한 종자를 선택하고 다시 심기 시작했다. 이것은 발명이라기보다는 느린 피드백 루프였다. 비옥한 초승달지대의 밀과 보리, 중국의 쌀, 메소아메리카의 옥수수, 안데스의 감자. 잉여 식량이 도시를 가능하게 했다.

segments.src: 2. **The agricultural revolutions (1700s–1800s).** Crop rotation replaced leaving fields fallow. Mechanical seed drills replaced broadcasting by hand. Justus von Liebig showed in the 1840s that plants take up mineral nutrients — turning soil fertility from folklore into chemistry.
segments.tr: 2. **농업 혁명 (1700s–1800s).** 윤작은 들판을 휴경하는 것을 대체했다. 기계식 파종기가 손으로 파종하는 것을 대체했다. 유스투스 폰 리비히는 1840년대에 식물이 미네랄 영양분을 흡수한다는 것을 보여주었다 — 토양 비옥도를 민간 전승에서 화학으로 바꾸었다.

segments.src: 3. **The synthetic era (1900s).** The Haber-Bosch process (1909–1913) pulled nitrogen out of the air to make fertilizer. Gregor Mendel's rediscovered genetics enabled systematic breeding. Hybrid corn, then the Green Revolution of the 1950s–60s, roughly tripled cereal yields in much of the world.
segments.tr: 3. **합성 시대 (1900s).** 하버-보슈 공정 (1909–1913)은 공기에서 질소를 뽑아 비료를 만들었다. 재발견된 그레고르 멘델의 유전학은 체계적인 육종을 가능하게 했다. 하이브리드 옥수수, 그리고 1950s–60s의 녹색 혁명은 세계의 많은 곳에서 곡물 수확량을 대략 3배로 늘렸다.

segments.src: 4. **The information era (now).** GPS-guided tractors, soil sensors, satellite imagery, genomic selection, and CRISPR gene editing. The bottleneck shifted from muscle to data.
segments.tr: 4. **정보 시대 (현재).** GPS 유도 트랙터, 토양 센서, 위성 이미지, 유전체 선택, CRISPR 유전자 편집. 병목은 근육에서 데이터로 옮겨졌다.

segments.src: **What's actually inside the field.** "Agriculture" in a university catalog usually splits roughly like this:
segments.tr: **들판 안에 실제로 무엇이 있는가.** 대학 카탈로그의 "농업"은 보통 대략 이렇게 나뉜다:

segments.src: - **Crop science / agronomy** — field crops, physiology, cropping systems
segments.tr: - **작물 과학 / 농학** — 작물, 생리학, 작물 재배 시스템

segments.src: - **Horticulture** — fruits, vegetables, ornamentals, controlled environments
segments.tr: - **원예** — 과일, 채소, 관상식물, 제어된 환경

segments.src: - **Soil science** — soil physics, chemistry, biology, fertility
segments.tr: - **토양 과학** — 토양 물리학, 화학, 생물학, 비옥도

segments.src: - **Animal science** — livestock nutrition, breeding, health, welfare
segments.tr: - **동물 과학** — 가축 영양, 육종, 건강, 복지

segments.src: - **Plant protection** — entomology, plant pathology, weed science
segments.tr: - **식물 보호** — 곤충학, 식물병리학, 잡초 과학

segments.src: - **Agricultural engineering** — machinery, irrigation, structures, automation
segments.tr: - **농업 공학** — 기계, 관개, 구조물, 자동화

segments.src: - **Agricultural economics** — markets, policy, farm management
segments.tr: - **농업 경제학** — 시장, 정책, 농장 관리

segments.src: - **Food science / post-harvest** — storage, processing, safety
segments.tr: - **식품 과학 / 수확 후** — 저장, 가공, 안전성

segments.src: - **Genetics and breeding** — cuts across nearly all of the above
segments.tr: - **유전학과 육종** — 위의 거의 모든 분야를 아우른다

segments.src: Notice that this list spans chemistry, biology, mechanical engineering, statistics, and economics.
segments.tr: 이 목록이 화학, 생물학, 기계 공학, 통계학, 경제학에 걸쳐 있음을 주목하라.

segments.src: Agriculture isn't a subfield of biology.
segments.tr: 농업은 생물학의 부분 분야가 아니다.

segments.src: It's an **integrative discipline** that pulls whatever it needs from the basic sciences and is judged by one question: did the system work in a real field, in a real season?
segments.tr: 그것은 기초 과학에서 필요한 무엇이든 끌어오고 한 가지 질문으로 판단되는 **통합 학문 분야**이다: 실제 들판에서, 실제 계절에 시스템이 작동했는가?

segments.src: **Why it still matters.** In 1900, roughly 40% of the U.S.
segments.tr: **왜 여전히 중요한가.** 1900년에 미국 노동력의 대략 40%가

segments.src: workforce farmed.
segments.tr: 농업에 종사했다.

segments.src: Today it's under 2%, and that 2% feeds the country with a large surplus for export.
segments.tr: 오늘날 그것은 2% 미만이고, 그 2%는 국가에 식량을 공급하고 수출할 큰 잉여를 만든다.

segments.src: That productivity gain is one of the largest in any sector of the economy — and it came almost entirely from research.
segments.tr: 그 생산성 향상은 경제의 어느 부문에서든 가장 큰 것 중 하나이다 — 그리고 그것은 거의 전적으로 연구에서 나왔다.

segments.src: But modern agriculture also has a bill attached.
segments.tr: 하지만 현대 농업은 또한 대가가 따른다.

segments.src: It uses about 70% of global freshwater withdrawals and generates a meaningful share of greenhouse gas emissions.
segments.tr: 그것은 전 지구적 담수 인출의 약 70%를 사용하고 온실 가스 배출의 의미 있는 부분을 생성한다.

segments.src: Fertilizer runoff from the Corn Belt flows down the Mississippi and drives a low-oxygen "dead zone" in the Gulf of Mexico that has averaged in the range of 5,000 square miles in recent years.
segments.tr: 옥수수벨트의 비료 유출은 미시시피를 따라 흘러내려 멕시코만의 저산소 "죽음의 지역"을 형성하는데, 최근 몇 년간 약 5,000제곱마일의 규모를 유지해왔다.

segments.src: So the modern research agenda isn't just *more yield* — it's yield per unit of water, per unit of nitrogen, per unit of emissions.
segments.tr: 그래서 현대 연구 의제는 단지 *더 높은 수확량*이 아니다 — 물 단위당 수확량, 질소 단위당 수확량, 배출량 단위당 수확량이다.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## 일상 생활에서

segments.src: Look at the price of a box of cereal at a Kroger in Ohio — say $4.99.
segments.tr: 오하이오의 크로거에서 시리얼 상자의 가격을 보자 — $4.99라고 하자.

segments.src: Under the USDA's accounting, only around 15 cents of every retail food dollar goes back to the farm.
segments.tr: USDA의 회계에 따르면, 모든 소매 식품 달러의 약 15센트만 농장으로 돌아간다.

segments.src: The rest is processing, packaging, transport, retail margin, and labor.
segments.tr: 나머지는 가공, 포장, 운송, 소매 마진, 노동이다.

segments.src: This is worth sitting with, because it reframes what agriculture *is*.
segments.tr: 이것은 깊이 생각할 가치가 있다. 농업 *이란 무엇인가*를 재구성하기 때문이다.

segments.src: When a drought hits Kansas and wheat futures spike 30% in Chicago, your cereal box doesn't jump 30% — it might move a few percent.
segments.tr: 가뭄이 캔자스를 덮치고 밀 선물이 시카고에서 30% 급등하면, 당신의 시리얼 상자는 30% 올라가지 않는다 — 몇 퍼센트 정도만 오를 수 있다.

segments.src: The farm is the base of a very tall stack.
segments.tr: 농장은 매우 높은 스택의 기초다.

segments.src: Now flip it.
segments.tr: 이제 반대로 해보자.

segments.src: A California almond grower decides whether to irrigate based on a soil moisture probe reporting to their phone.
segments.tr: 캘리포니아 아몬드 재배자는 휴대폰에 보고하는 토양 수분 프로브를 기반으로 관개할지 여부를 결정한다.

segments.src: Their decision reflects Central Valley water allocations, the price of diesel, an export contract to India, and a labor market.
segments.tr: 그들의 결정은 중앙 밸리 물 할당, 디젤 가격, 인도로의 수출 계약, 노동 시장을 반영한다.

segments.src: One irrigation call is simultaneously a biology problem, an engineering problem, and an economics problem.
segments.tr: 하나의 관개 결정은 동시에 생물학 문제, 공학 문제, 경제학 문제다.

segments.src: That's the field in miniature.
segments.tr: 그것이 축소된 들판이다.

segments.src: When people say agriculture is "low-tech," they're usually looking at the picturesque parts — a barn, a field, a tractor at sunset.
segments.tr: 사람들이 농업이 "저기술"이라고 말할 때, 그들은 보통 그림 같은 부분을 본다 — 헛간, 들판, 석양의 트랙터.

segments.src: The actual work is closer to running a distributed biological factory where the machinery grows, the inputs are weather-dependent, and you get roughly one production run per year to learn from.
segments.tr: 실제 일은 기계가 자라고, 투입물이 날씨에 의존하며, 배울 수 있는 연간 대략 하나의 생산 주기를 얻는 분산된 생물학적 공장을 운영하는 것에 더 가깝다.

segments.src: ## Three-Line Summary
segments.tr: ## 세 줄 요약

segments.src: 1. Agriculture is the deliberate management of biological systems — plants, animals, soil, microbes — to produce food, fiber, and fuel, and it's a science because those systems can be steered but never fully controlled.
segments.tr: 1. 농업은 식량, 섬유, 연료를 생산하기 위해 생물 체계(식물, 동물, 토양, 미생물)를 의도적으로 관리하는 것이며, 그 체계들이 조정될 수 있지만 절대 완전히 통제될 수 없기 때문에 과학이다.

segments.src: 2. It advanced in four broad phases: domestication, the crop-rotation and mechanization revolutions, the synthetic-input and breeding era, and today's data-driven precision era.
segments.tr: 2. 그것은 네 가지 광범위한 단계로 발전했다: 가축화, 윤작과 기계화 혁명, 합성 투입과 육종 시대, 그리고 오늘날의 데이터 주도 정밀 시대.

segments.src: 3. It's an integrative discipline spanning agronomy, horticulture, soil science, animal science, engineering, and economics — now measured not only by yield but by yield per unit of water, nitrogen, and emissions.
segments.tr: 3. 그것은 농학, 원예, 토양 과학, 동물 과학, 공학, 경제학을 아우르는 통합 학문이다 — 이제 수확량뿐만 아니라 물, 질소, 배출량 단위당 수확량으로도 측정된다.

segments.src: ## ✅ Self Quiz
segments.tr: ## ✅ 자가진단 퀴즈

segments.src: Which best describes why agriculture is treated as an applied science rather than a pure science?**
segments.tr: 농업이 순수 과학이 아니라 응용 과학으로 취급되는 이유를 가장 잘 설명하는 것은?**

segments.src: - (A) It uses more expensive equipment than pure sciences
segments.tr: - (A) 순수 과학보다 더 비싼 장비를 사용한다

segments.src: - (B) It integrates knowledge from multiple basic sciences and is judged by whether systems work under real field conditions
segments.tr: - (B) 여러 기초 과학의 지식을 통합하고 실제 들판 조건에서 시스템이 작동하는지에 따라 판단된다

segments.src: - (C) It is older than physics and chemistry
segments.tr: - (C) 물리학과 화학보다 오래되었다

segments.src: - (D) It does not use the scientific method
segments.tr: - (D) 과학적 방법을 사용하지 않는다

segments.src: The Haber-Bosch process was significant to agriculture mainly because it:**
segments.tr: 하버-보슈 공정이 농업에 중요한 이유는 주로:**

segments.src: - (A) Made mechanical harvesting possible
segments.tr: - (A) 기계 수확을 가능하게 했다

segments.src: - (B) Enabled industrial production of nitrogen fertilizer from atmospheric nitrogen
segments.tr: - (B) 대기 질소에서 질소 비료의 산업 생산을 가능하게 했다

segments.src: - (C) Introduced crop rotation to European farming
segments.tr: - (C) 유럽 농업에 윤작을 소개했다

segments.src: - (D) Established the principles of plant genetics
segments.tr: - (D) 식물 유전학의 원리를 확립했다

segments.tr: 농부에게 간다.**

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 오늘의 용어

segments.src: - **Agronomy** — The science of field crop production and soil management, focused on large-scale staples like corn, wheat, and soybeans.
segments.tr: - **농학** — 옥수수, 밀, 대두 같은 대규모 주식 작물에 초점을 맞춘 작물 생산과 토양 관리의 과학.

segments.src: - **Horticulture** — The science of intensively cultivated plants: fruits, vegetables, ornamentals, and greenhouse or controlled-environment crops.
segments.tr: - **원예** — 과일, 채소, 관상식물, 온실 또는 제어된 환경 작물 같은 집약적으로 재배된 식물의 과학.

segments.src: - **Domestication** — The long process by which humans selectively bred wild species into forms dependent on and suited to cultivation.
segments.tr: - **가축화** — 인간이 야생종을 선택적으로 번식시켜 재배에 의존적이고 적합한 형태로 만든 긴 과정.

segments.src: - **Green Revolution** — The mid-20th-century package of high-yielding dwarf varieties, fertilizer, irrigation, and pest control that sharply raised cereal yields, especially in Asia and Latin America.
segments.tr: - **녹색 혁명** — 특히 아시아와 라틴 아메리카에서 곡물 수확량을 급격히 높인, 고수확 왜성 품종, 비료, 관개, 해충 방제의 20세기 중반 패키지.

segments.src: - **Precision agriculture** — Managing within-field variability using GPS, sensors, and data analytics to apply inputs at the right rate, place, and time.
segments.tr: - **정밀 농업** — GPS, 센서, 데이터 분석을 사용하여 들판 내 변동성을 관리하고 올바른 속도, 장소, 시간에 투입물을 적용하는 것.

segments.src: *Answers: 1-(B).
Agriculture borrows from biology, chemistry, engineering, and economics, and its findings are validated in actual fields, not just controlled labs.

segments.src: Haber-Bosch fixes atmospheric nitrogen into ammonia, making synthetic fertilizer available at industrial scale — arguably the single largest driver of 20th-century yield gains.

zh.title: [农业101 #1] 你每天使用三次的最古老技术

segments.src: > Agriculture is the applied science of managing living systems — plants, animals, soil, and microbes — to produce food, fiber, and fuel, and today it borrows as much from data science as from botany.
segments.tr: > 农业是管理生命系统（植物、动物、土壤和微生物）以生产食物、纤维和燃料的应用科学，如今它从数据科学中获取的知识与从植物学中获取的一样多。

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## 今天的概念

segments.src: Most people picture agriculture as a job.
segments.tr: 大多数人把农业看作一份工作。

segments.src: Academically, it's a **discipline** — one of the oldest organized bodies of applied knowledge we have.
segments.tr: 在学术上，它是一门**学科** — 我们拥有的最古老的有组织的应用知识体系之一。

segments.src: Here's the shortest useful definition: **agriculture is the deliberate management of biological systems to produce things humans need.** Every word carries weight.
segments.tr: 这是最简洁的有用定义：**农业是为了生产人类需要的东西而对生物系统的刻意管理。** 每个字都很重要。

segments.src: *Deliberate* separates it from foraging.
segments.tr: *刻意*将其与采集区分开来。

segments.src: *Biological systems* means you're working with organisms that grow, reproduce, get sick, and die on their own schedule.
segments.tr: *生物系统*意味着你在处理按照自己时间表生长、繁殖、患病和死亡的生物。

segments.src: *Manage* means you don't control them — you nudge them.
segments.tr: *管理*意味着你不能控制它们 — 你只能推动它们。

segments.src: That last point is the whole reason agriculture became a science instead of a craft.
segments.tr: 最后这一点是农业成为科学而非工艺的全部原因。

segments.src: A civil engineer specifying a steel beam knows the yield strength.
segments.tr: 指定钢梁的土木工程师知道屈服强度。

segments.src: A farmer planting corn is negotiating with weather, soil chemistry, insect populations, and a genome — none of which sends a spec sheet.
segments.tr: 种植玉米的农民在与天气、土壤化学、昆虫种群和基因组协商 — 其中没有一个会发送规格说明书。

segments.src: **A quick history, in four moves:**
segments.tr: **简明历史，分四个阶段：**

segments.src: 1. **Domestication (~10,000 BCE).** Humans in several regions independently began selecting and replanting favorable seeds. This wasn't invention so much as a slow feedback loop. Wheat and barley in the Fertile Crescent, rice in China, maize in Mesoamerica, potatoes in the Andes. Surplus food made cities possible.
segments.tr: 1. **驯化（约公元前10,000年）。** 多个地区的人类独立地开始选择和重新种植良好的种子。这与其说是发明，不如说是一个缓慢的反馈循环。肥沃新月地带的小麦和大麦、中国的水稻、中美洲的玉米、安第斯山脉的土豆。剩余粮食使城市成为可能。

segments.src: 2. **The agricultural revolutions (1700s–1800s).** Crop rotation replaced leaving fields fallow. Mechanical seed drills replaced broadcasting by hand. Justus von Liebig showed in the 1840s that plants take up mineral nutrients — turning soil fertility from folklore into chemistry.
segments.tr: 2. **农业革命（1700年代-1800年代）。** 轮作取代了让田地休闲。机械播种机取代了手工播种。尤斯图斯·冯·李比希在1840年代表明植物吸收矿物养分 — 将土壤肥力从民间传说转变为化学。

segments.src: 3. **The synthetic era (1900s).** The Haber-Bosch process (1909–1913) pulled nitrogen out of the air to make fertilizer. Gregor Mendel's rediscovered genetics enabled systematic breeding. Hybrid corn, then the Green Revolution of the 1950s–60s, roughly tripled cereal yields in much of the world.
segments.tr: 3. **合成时代（1900年代）。** 哈伯-博施工艺（1909-1913年）从空气中提取氮气制造肥料。格雷戈尔·孟德尔重新发现的遗传学使系统性育种成为可能。杂交玉米，然后是1950年代-60年代的绿色革命，使世界许多地区的谷物产量大致增加了三倍。

segments.src: 4. **The information era (now).** GPS-guided tractors, soil sensors, satellite imagery, genomic selection, and CRISPR gene editing. The bottleneck shifted from muscle to data.
segments.tr: 4. **信息时代（现在）。** GPS引导的拖拉机、土壤传感器、卫星影像、基因组选择和CRISPR基因编辑。瓶颈从肌肉转变为数据。

segments.src: **What's actually inside the field.** "Agriculture" in a university catalog usually splits roughly like this:
segments.tr: **田地里实际上有什么。** "农业"在大学目录中通常大致分为：

segments.src: - **Crop science / agronomy** — field crops, physiology, cropping systems
segments.tr: - **作物科学/农学** — 田间作物、生理学、种植系统

segments.src: - **Horticulture** — fruits, vegetables, ornamentals, controlled environments
segments.tr: - **园艺学** — 水果、蔬菜、观赏植物、受控环境

segments.src: - **Soil science** — soil physics, chemistry, biology, fertility
segments.tr: - **土壤科学** — 土壤物理、化学、生物学、肥力

segments.src: - **Animal science** — livestock nutrition, breeding, health, welfare
segments.tr: - **动物科学** — 畜牧营养、育种、健康、福利

segments.src: - **Plant protection** — entomology, plant pathology, weed science
segments.tr: - **植物保护** — 昆虫学、植物病理学、杂草科学

segments.src: - **Agricultural engineering** — machinery, irrigation, structures, automation
segments.tr: - **农业工程** — 机械、灌溉、结构、自动化

segments.src: - **Agricultural economics** — markets, policy, farm management
segments.tr: - **农业经济学** — 市场、政策、农场管理

segments.src: - **Food science / post-harvest** — storage, processing, safety
segments.tr: - **食品科学/收后** — 储存、加工、安全

segments.src: - **Genetics and breeding** — cuts across nearly all of the above
segments.tr: - **遗传学和育种** — 贯穿以上几乎所有内容

segments.src: Notice that this list spans chemistry, biology, mechanical engineering, statistics, and economics.
segments.tr: 注意这个清单跨越化学、生物学、机械工程、统计学和经济学。

segments.src: Agriculture isn't a subfield of biology.
segments.tr: 农业不是生物学的一个子领域。

segments.src: It's an **integrative discipline** that pulls whatever it needs from the basic sciences and is judged by one question: did the system work in a real field, in a real season?
segments.tr: 它是一门**综合学科**，从基础科学中汲取所需的任何东西，并由一个问题来判断：系统在真实的田地里、在真实的季节里是否有效？

segments.src: **Why it still matters.** In 1900, roughly 40% of the U.S.
segments.tr: **为什么它仍然重要。** 在1900年，美国大约40%

segments.src: workforce farmed.
segments.tr: 的劳动力从事农业。

segments.src: Today it's under 2%, and that 2% feeds the country with a large surplus for export.
segments.tr: 今天不到2%，那2%用大量剩余粮食养活了这个国家并用于出口。

segments.src: That productivity gain is one of the largest in any sector of the economy — and it came almost entirely from research.
segments.tr: 这种生产率的提高是经济中任何部门中最大的之一 — 它几乎完全来自研究。

segments.src: But modern agriculture also has a bill attached.
segments.tr: 但现代农业也有代价。

segments.src: It uses about 70% of global freshwater withdrawals and generates a meaningful share of greenhouse gas emissions.
segments.tr: 它使用约70%的全球淡水提取量，并产生大量温室气体排放。

segments.src: Fertilizer runoff from the Corn Belt flows down the Mississippi and drives a low-oxygen "dead zone" in the Gulf of Mexico that has averaged in the range of 5,000 square miles in recent years.
segments.tr: 来自玉米带的肥料径流流经密西西比河，在墨西哥湾驱动一个低氧"死区"，近年来平均面积在5,000平方英里左右。

segments.src: So the modern research agenda isn't just *more yield* — it's yield per unit of water, per unit of nitrogen, per unit of emissions.
segments.tr: 所以现代研究议程不仅仅是*更高产量* — 它是每单位水、每单位氮、每单位排放的产量。

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## 日常生活中

segments.src: Look at the price of a box of cereal at a Kroger in Ohio — say $4.99.
segments.tr: 看一下俄亥俄州Kroger超市一盒谷物早餐的价格 — 比如4.99美元。

segments.src: Under the USDA's accounting, only around 15 cents of every retail food dollar goes back to the farm.
segments.tr: 根据美国农业部的核算，零售食品每一美元中只有大约15美分返回农场。

segments.src: The rest is processing, packaging, transport, retail margin, and labor.
segments.tr: 其余是加工、包装、运输、零售利润和劳动力。

segments.src: This is worth sitting with, because it reframes what agriculture *is*.
segments.tr: 这值得深思，因为它重新框架了农业*是什么*。

segments.src: When a drought hits Kansas and wheat futures spike 30% in Chicago, your cereal box doesn't jump 30% — it might move a few percent.
segments.tr: 当干旱袭击堪萨斯州，芝加哥的小麦期货上涨30%时，你的谷物早餐盒不会上涨30% — 它可能只会上升几个百分点。

segments.src: The farm is the base of a very tall stack.
segments.tr: 农场是一个非常高的堆栈的基础。

segments.src: Now flip it.
segments.tr: 现在反过来看。

segments.src: A California almond grower decides whether to irrigate based on a soil moisture probe reporting to their phone.
segments.tr: 加州杏仁种植者根据向其手机报告的土壤湿度探针决定是否灌溉。

segments.src: Their decision reflects Central Valley water allocations, the price of diesel, an export contract to India, and a labor market.
segments.tr: 他们的决定反映了中央谷地的水资源分配、柴油价格、对印度的出口合同和劳动力市场。

segments.src: One irrigation call is simultaneously a biology problem, an engineering problem, and an economics problem.
segments.tr: 一个灌溉决定同时是一个生物学问题、工程问题和经济问题。

segments.src: That's the field in miniature.
segments.tr: 这就是缩小版的田地。

segments.src: When people say agriculture is "low-tech," they're usually looking at the picturesque parts — a barn, a field, a tractor at sunset.
segments.tr: 当人们说农业是"低技术"时，他们通常看的是风景如画的部分 — 谷仓、田地、日落时的拖拉机。

segments.src: The actual work is closer to running a distributed biological factory where the machinery grows, the inputs are weather-dependent, and you get roughly one production run per year to learn from.
segments.tr: 实际工作更接近于运行一个分布式生物工厂，其中机械会生长，投入取决于天气，你每年大约只能进行一次生产来学习。

segments.src: ## Three-Line Summary
segments.tr: ## 三行摘要

segments.src: 1. Agriculture is the deliberate management of biological systems — plants, animals, soil, microbes — to produce food, fiber, and fuel, and it's a science because those systems can be steered but never fully controlled.
segments.tr: 1. 农业是为了生产食物、纤维和燃料而对生物系统（植物、动物、土壤、微生物）的刻意管理，它是一门科学，因为这些系统可以被引导但永远不能被完全控制。

segments.src: 2. It advanced in four broad phases: domestication, the crop-rotation and mechanization revolutions, the synthetic-input and breeding era, and today's data-driven precision era.
segments.tr: 2. 它分四个阶段发展：驯化、轮作和机械化革命、合成投入和育种时代，以及今天以数据驱动的精准时代。

segments.src: 3. It's an integrative discipline spanning agronomy, horticulture, soil science, animal science, engineering, and economics — now measured not only by yield but by yield per unit of water, nitrogen, and emissions.
segments.tr: 3. 它是一门整合学科，涵盖农学、园艺、土壤科学、动物科学、工程和经济学 — 现在不仅按产量衡量，还按每单位水、氮和排放的产量衡量。

segments.tr: ## ✅ 自我测验

segments.tr: - (A) 使机械收获成为可能

segments.tr: - (B) 使大气氮工业化生产氮肥成为可能

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 今天的术语

segments.src: - **Agronomy** — The science of field crop production and soil management, focused on large-scale staples like corn, wheat, and soybeans.
segments.tr: - **农学** — 田间作物生产和土壤管理的科学，专注于玉米、小麦和大豆等大规模主食。

segments.src: - **Horticulture** — The science of intensively cultivated plants: fruits, vegetables, ornamentals, and greenhouse or controlled-environment crops.
segments.tr: - **园艺学** — 集约栽培植物的科学：水果、蔬菜、观赏植物以及温室或受控环境作物。

segments.src: - **Domestication** — The long process by which humans selectively bred wild species into forms dependent on and suited to cultivation.
segments.tr: - **驯化** — 人类选择性地将野生物种培育成依赖于并适合栽培的形式的长期过程。

segments.src: - **Green Revolution** — The mid-20th-century package of high-yielding dwarf varieties, fertilizer, irrigation, and pest control that sharply raised cereal yields, especially in Asia and Latin America.
segments.tr: - **绿色革命** — 20世纪中期的高产矮秆品种、肥料、灌溉和病虫害防治套装，大大提高了谷物产量，特别是在亚洲和拉丁美洲。

segments.src: - **Precision agriculture** — Managing within-field variability using GPS, sensors, and data analytics to apply inputs at the right rate, place, and time.
segments.tr: - **精准农业** — 使用GPS、传感器和数据分析管理田间差异性，以适当的速率、地点和时间应用投入。

segments.src: *Answers: 1-(B).
Agriculture borrows from biology, chemistry, engineering, and economics, and its findings are validated in actual fields, not just controlled labs.
segments.tr: 农业借用生物学、化学、工程和经济学，其发现在实际田地中得到验证，而不仅仅是受控实验室。

segments.tr: 哈伯-博施将大气氮固定成氨，使合成肥料在工业规模上可用 — 可以说是20世纪产量增长的最大驱动力。

segments.src: > Agriculture is the applied science of managing living systems — plants, animals, soil, and microbes — to produce food, fiber, and fuel, and today it borrows as much from data science as from botany.

segments.src: Most people picture agriculture as a job.

segments.src: Here's the shortest useful definition: **agriculture is the deliberate management of biological systems to produce things humans need.** Every word carries weight.
segments.tr: यहाँ सबसे छोटी उपयोगी परिभाषा है: **कृषि मानव-आवश्यक चीजों का उत्पादन करने के लिए जैविक प्रणालियों का जानबूझकर प्रबंधन है।** प्रत्येक शब्द का वजन है।

segments.src: *Deliberate* separates it from foraging.
segments.tr: *जानबूझकर* इसे भोजन संग्रह से अलग करता है।

segments.src: *Biological systems* means you're working with organisms that grow, reproduce, get sick, and die on their own schedule.
segments.tr: *जैविक प्रणालियां* का अर्थ है कि आप ऐसे जीवों के साथ काम कर रहे हैं जो अपने स्वयं के कार्यक्रम पर बढ़ते हैं, प्रजनन करते हैं, बीमार पड़ते हैं, और मर जाते हैं।

segments.src: *Manage* means you don't control them — you nudge them.
segments.tr: *प्रबंधन* का अर्थ है कि आप उन्हें नियंत्रित नहीं करते — आप उन्हें धीरे से धकेलते हैं।

segments.src: That last point is the whole reason agriculture became a science instead of a craft.
segments.tr: वह अंतिम बिंदु पूरी वजह है कि कृषि एक कला के बजाय एक विज्ञान बन गई।

segments.src: A civil engineer specifying a steel beam knows the yield strength.
segments.tr: एक नागरिक इंजीनियर जो स्टील बीम को निर्दिष्ट करता है, वह उपज की शक्ति जानता है।

segments.src: A farmer planting corn is negotiating with weather, soil chemistry, insect populations, and a genome — none of which sends a spec sheet.
segments.tr: एक किसान जो मकई लगा रहा है, वह मौसम, मिट्टी की रसायनशास्त्र, कीट जनसंख्या, और एक जीनोम के साथ बातचीत कर रहा है — जिनमें से कोई भी विनिर्देश पत्र नहीं भेजता।

segments.src: **A quick history, in four moves:**
segments.tr: **एक संक्षिप्त इतिहास, चार चालों में:**

segments.src: 1. **Domestication (~10,000 BCE).** Humans in several regions independently began selecting and replanting favorable seeds. This wasn't invention so much as a slow feedback loop. Wheat and barley in the Fertile Crescent, rice in China, maize in Mesoamerica, potatoes in the Andes. Surplus food made cities possible.
segments.tr: 1. **पालतूकरण (~10,000 BCE).** कई क्षेत्रों के मनुष्यों ने स्वतंत्र रूप से अनुकूल बीजों का चयन और पुनः रोपण शुरू किया। यह आविष्कार से कहीं अधिक एक धीमी प्रतिक्रिया लूप था। फर्टाइल क्रेसेंट में गेहूं और जौ, चीन में चावल, मेसोअमेरिका में मक्का, एंडीज में आलू। अतिरिक्त भोजन ने शहरों को संभव बना दिया।

segments.src: 2. **The agricultural revolutions (1700s–1800s).** Crop rotation replaced leaving fields fallow. Mechanical seed drills replaced broadcasting by hand. Justus von Liebig showed in the 1840s that plants take up mineral nutrients — turning soil fertility from folklore into chemistry.
segments.tr: 2. **कृषि क्रांतियां (1700s–1800s).** फसल चक्र ने खेतों को परती छोड़ने की जगह ली। यांत्रिक बीज बोने की मशीनों ने हाथ से बीज बोने की जगह ली। Justus von Liebig ने 1840 के दशक में दिखाया कि पौधे खनिज पोषक तत्वों को अवशोषित करते हैं — मिट्टी की उर्वरता को लोककथा से रसायन विज्ञान में बदल दिया।

segments.src: 3. **The synthetic era (1900s).** The Haber-Bosch process (1909–1913) pulled nitrogen out of the air to make fertilizer. Gregor Mendel's rediscovered genetics enabled systematic breeding. Hybrid corn, then the Green Revolution of the 1950s–60s, roughly tripled cereal yields in much of the world.
segments.tr: 3. **सिंथेटिक युग (1900s).** Haber-Bosch प्रक्रिया (1909–1913) ने खाद बनाने के लिए हवा से नाइट्रोजन निकाली। Gregor Mendel की पुनः खोजी गई आनुवंशिकता ने व्यवस्थित प्रजनन को सक्षम किया। संकर मकई, फिर 1950s–60s की हरित क्रांति, दुनिया के अधिकांश हिस्सों में अनाज की पैदावार को लगभग तीन गुना बढ़ा दी।

segments.src: 4. **The information era (now).** GPS-guided tractors, soil sensors, satellite imagery, genomic selection, and CRISPR gene editing. The bottleneck shifted from muscle to data.
segments.tr: 4. **सूचना युग (अब).** GPS-निर्देशित ट्रैक्टर, मिट्टी सेंसर, उपग्रह चित्र, जीनोमिक चयन, और CRISPR जीन संपादन। बाधा मांसपेशी से डेटा तक स्थानांतरित हो गई।

segments.src: **What's actually inside the field.** "Agriculture" in a university catalog usually splits roughly like this:
segments.tr: **वास्तव में क्षेत्र के अंदर क्या है।** एक विश्वविद्यालय कैटलॉग में "कृषि" आमतौर पर इस तरह विभाजित होता है:

segments.src: - **Crop science / agronomy** — field crops, physiology, cropping systems
segments.tr: - **फसल विज्ञान / कृषि विज्ञान** — खेत की फसलें, शरीर विज्ञान, फसल उगाने की प्रणालियां

segments.src: - **Horticulture** — fruits, vegetables, ornamentals, controlled environments
segments.tr: - **बागवानी** — फल, सब्जियां, सजावटी पौधे, नियंत्रित वातावरण

segments.src: - **Soil science** — soil physics, chemistry, biology, fertility
segments.tr: - **मिट्टी विज्ञान** — मिट्टी का भौतिकी, रसायन विज्ञान, जीव विज्ञान, उर्वरता

segments.src: - **Animal science** — livestock nutrition, breeding, health, welfare
segments.tr: - **पशु विज्ञान** — पशुधन पोषण, प्रजनन, स्वास्थ्य, कल्याण

segments.src: - **Plant protection** — entomology, plant pathology, weed science
segments.tr: - **पौधा संरक्षण** — कीट विज्ञान, पौधा रोग विज्ञान, खरपतवार विज्ञान

segments.src: - **Agricultural engineering** — machinery, irrigation, structures, automation
segments.tr: - **कृषि इंजीनियरिंग** — मशीनरी, सिंचाई, संरचनाएं, स्वचालन

segments.src: - **Agricultural economics** — markets, policy, farm management
segments.tr: - **कृषि अर्थशास्त्र** — बाजार, नीति, खेत प्रबंधन

segments.src: - **Food science / post-harvest** — storage, processing, safety
segments.tr: - **खाद्य विज्ञान / कटाई के बाद** — भंडारण, प्रसंस्करण, सुरक्षा

segments.src: - **Genetics and breeding** — cuts across nearly all of the above
segments.tr: - **आनुवंशिकता और प्रजनन** — उपरोक्त सभी के बीच विस्तृत

segments.src: Notice that this list spans chemistry, biology, mechanical engineering, statistics, and economics.
segments.tr: ध्यान दें कि यह सूची रसायन विज्ञान, जीव विज्ञान, यांत्रिक इंजीनियरिंग, सांख्यिकी, और अर्थशास्त्र में विस्तृत है।

segments.src: Agriculture isn't a subfield of biology.
segments.tr: कृषि जीव विज्ञान का एक उप-क्षेत्र नहीं है।

segments.src: It's an **integrative discipline** that pulls whatever it needs from the basic sciences and is judged by one question: did the system work in a real field, in a real season?
segments.tr: यह एक **समन्वयात्मक अनुशासन** है जो मूल विज्ञानों से जो भी चाहिए वह खींचता है और एक प्रश्न से आंका जाता है: क्या सिस्टम एक वास्तविक क्षेत्र में, एक वास्तविक मौसम में काम करता है?

segments.src: **Why it still matters.** In 1900, roughly 40% of the U.S.
segments.tr: **यह अभी भी क्यों महत्वपूर्ण है।** 1900 में, लगभग 40% U.S.

segments.src: workforce farmed.
segments.tr: कार्यबल ने खेती की।

segments.src: Today it's under 2%, and that 2% feeds the country with a large surplus for export.
segments.tr: आज यह 2% से कम है, और वह 2% निर्यात के लिए एक बड़े अतिरिक्त के साथ देश को खिलाता है।

segments.src: That productivity gain is one of the largest in any sector of the economy — and it came almost entirely from research.
segments.tr: यह उत्पादकता लाभ अर्थव्यवस्था के किसी भी क्षेत्र में सबसे बड़ा है — और यह लगभग पूरी तरह अनुसंधान से आया।

segments.src: But modern agriculture also has a bill attached.
segments.tr: लेकिन आधुनिक कृषि के साथ एक बिल भी जुड़ा है।

segments.src: It uses about 70% of global freshwater withdrawals and generates a meaningful share of greenhouse gas emissions.
segments.tr: यह वैश्विक मीठे पानी की खपत का लगभग 70% उपयोग करता है और ग्रीनहाउस गैस उत्सर्जन का एक सार्थक हिस्सा उत्पन्न करता है।

segments.src: Fertilizer runoff from the Corn Belt flows down the Mississippi and drives a low-oxygen "dead zone" in the Gulf of Mexico that has averaged in the range of 5,000 square miles in recent years.
segments.tr: कॉर्न बेल्ट से खाद का अपवाह मिसिसिप्पी नीचे बहता है और मेक्सिको की खाड़ी में एक कम-ऑक्सीजन "मृत क्षेत्र" को चलाता है जो हाल के वर्षों में 5,000 वर्ग मील की सीमा में औसत है।

segments.src: So the modern research agenda isn't just *more yield* — it's yield per unit of water, per unit of nitrogen, per unit of emissions.
segments.tr: तो आधुनिक अनुसंधान एजेंडा सिर्फ *अधिक पैदावार* नहीं है — यह पानी की प्रति इकाई पैदावार है, नाइट्रोजन की प्रति इकाई, उत्सर्जन की प्रति इकाई।

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## रोजमर्रा की जिंदगी में

segments.src: Look at the price of a box of cereal at a Kroger in Ohio — say $4.99.
segments.tr: ओहियो में एक Kroger पर अनाज के एक बॉक्स की कीमत देखें — मान लीजिए $4.99।

segments.src: Under the USDA's accounting, only around 15 cents of every retail food dollar goes back to the farm.
segments.tr: USDA की लेखांकन के तहत, प्रत्येक खुदरा खाद्य डॉलर का केवल लगभग 15 सेंट खेत को वापस जाता है।

segments.src: The rest is processing, packaging, transport, retail margin, and labor.
segments.tr: बाकी प्रसंस्करण, पैकेजिंग, परिवहन, खुदरा मार्जिन, और श्रम है।

segments.src: This is worth sitting with, because it reframes what agriculture *is*.
segments.tr: यह बैठने के लायक है, क्योंकि यह कृषि को पुनः परिभाषित करता है *क्या है*।

segments.src: When a drought hits Kansas and wheat futures spike 30% in Chicago, your cereal box doesn't jump 30% — it might move a few percent.
segments.tr: जब सूखा कंसास को मारता है और गेहूं की भविष्य की कीमत शिकागो में 30% बढ़ जाती है, तो आपका अनाज बॉक्स 30% नहीं बढ़ता — यह कुछ प्रतिशत बढ़ सकता है।

segments.src: The farm is the base of a very tall stack.
segments.tr: खेत बहुत ऊंचे ढेर का आधार है।

segments.src: Now flip it.
segments.tr: अब इसे पलटें।

segments.src: A California almond grower decides whether to irrigate based on a soil moisture probe reporting to their phone.
segments.tr: एक कैलिफोर्निया बादाम उगाने वाला यह तय करता है कि अपने फोन को रिपोर्ट करने वाली मिट्टी की नमी जांच के आधार पर सिंचाई करना है या नहीं।

segments.src: Their decision reflects Central Valley water allocations, the price of diesel, an export contract to India, and a labor market.
segments.tr: उनका निर्णय Central Valley जल आवंटन, डीजल की कीमत, भारत को एक निर्यात अनुबंध, और एक श्रम बाजार को दर्शाता है।

segments.src: One irrigation call is simultaneously a biology problem, an engineering problem, and an economics problem.
segments.tr: एक सिंचाई कॉल एक साथ एक जीव विज्ञान समस्या, एक इंजीनियरिंग समस्या, और एक अर्थशास्त्र समस्या है।

segments.src: That's the field in miniature.
segments.tr: यह लघु में क्षेत्र है।

segments.src: When people say agriculture is "low-tech," they're usually looking at the picturesque parts — a barn, a field, a tractor at sunset.
segments.tr: जब लोग कहते हैं कि कृषि "कम तकनीकी" है, तो वे आमतौर पर मनोरम भागों को देख रहे हैं — एक खलिहान, एक क्षेत्र, सूर्यास्त पर एक ट्रैक्टर।

segments.src: The actual work is closer to running a distributed biological factory where the machinery grows, the inputs are weather-dependent, and you get roughly one production run per year to learn from.
segments.tr: वास्तविक काम एक वितरित जैविक कारखाने को चलाने के करीब है जहां मशीनरी बढ़ता है, इनपुट मौसम पर निर्भर होते हैं, और आप सीखने के लिए लगभग साल में एक बार उत्पादन चलाते हैं।

segments.src: ## Three-Line Summary
segments.tr: ## तीन-पंक्ति सारांश

segments.src: 1. Agriculture is the deliberate management of biological systems — plants, animals, soil, microbes — to produce food, fiber, and fuel, and it's a science because those systems can be steered but never fully controlled.
segments.tr: 1. कृषि जैविक प्रणालियों — पौधों, जानवरों, मिट्टी, सूक्ष्मजीवों — का जानबूझकर प्रबंधन है जो भोजन, फाइबर, और ईंधन का उत्पादन करता है, और यह एक विज्ञान है क्योंकि उन प्रणालियों को नियंत्रित किया जा सकता है लेकिन कभी भी पूरी तरह से नियंत्रित नहीं किया जा सकता।

segments.src: 2. It advanced in four broad phases: domestication, the crop-rotation and mechanization revolutions, the synthetic-input and breeding era, and today's data-driven precision era.
segments.tr: 2. यह चार व्यापक चरणों में आगे बढ़ा: पालतूकरण, फसल-चक्र और यांत्रीकरण क्रांतियां, सिंथेटिक-इनपुट और प्रजनन युग, और आज का डेटा-संचालित सटीकता युग।

segments.src: 3. It's an integrative discipline spanning agronomy, horticulture, soil science, animal science, engineering, and economics — now measured not only by yield but by yield per unit of water, nitrogen, and emissions.
segments.tr: 3. यह कृषि विज्ञान, बागवानी, मिट्टी विज्ञान, पशु विज्ञान, इंजीनियरिंग, और अर्थशास्त्र में विस्तृत एक समन्वयात्मक अनुशासन है — अब केवल पैदावार से नहीं बल्कि पानी, नाइट्रोजन, और उत्सर्जन की प्रति इकाई पैदावार से मापा जाता है।

segments.tr: ## ✅ स्व-प्रश्नोत्तरी

segments.src: - (B) It integrates knowledge from multiple basic sciences and is judged by whether systems work under real field conditions

segments.src: - (C) It is older than physics and chemistry
segments.tr: - (C) यह भौतिकी और रसायन विज्ञान से पुराना है

segments.src: - (D) It does not use the scientific method

segments.src: The Haber-Bosch process was significant to agriculture mainly because it:**
segments.tr: Haber-Bosch प्रक्रिया मुख्य रूप से कृषि के लिए महत्वपूर्ण थी क्योंकि यह:**

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 आज की शर्तें

segments.src: - **Agronomy** — The science of field crop production and soil management, focused on large-scale staples like corn, wheat, and soybeans.
segments.tr: - **कृषि विज्ञान** — खेत की फसल उत्पादन और मिट्टी प्रबंधन का विज्ञान, जो मकई, गेहूं, और सोयाबीन जैसे बड़े पैमाने पर मुख्य वस्तुओं पर केंद्रित है।

segments.src: - **Horticulture** — The science of intensively cultivated plants: fruits, vegetables, ornamentals, and greenhouse or controlled-environment crops.
segments.tr: - **बागवानी** — गहनता से खेती किए गए पौधों का विज्ञान: फल, सब्जियां, सजावटी पौधे, और ग्रीनहाउस या नियंत्रित-पर्यावरण फसलें।

es.title: [Agriculture 101 #1] La tecnología más antigua que usas tres veces al día

segments.src: > Agriculture is the applied science of managing living systems — plants, animals, soil, and microbes — to produce food, fiber, and fuel, and today it borrows as much from data science as from botany.
segments.tr: > La agricultura es la ciencia aplicada de gestionar sistemas vivos — plantas, animales, suelo y microbios — para producir alimentos, fibras y combustible, y hoy en día toma tanto de la ciencia de datos como de la botánica.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## Concepto de hoy

segments.src: Most people picture agriculture as a job.
segments.tr: La mayoría de las personas imaginan la agricultura como un trabajo.

segments.src: Academically, it's a **discipline** — one of the oldest organized bodies of applied knowledge we have.
segments.tr: Académicamente, es una **disciplina** — uno de los cuerpos más antiguos de conocimiento aplicado organizado que tenemos.

segments.src: Here's the shortest useful definition: **agriculture is the deliberate management of biological systems to produce things humans need.** Every word carries weight.
segments.tr: Aquí está la definición más útil y breve: **la agricultura es la gestión deliberada de sistemas biológicos para producir cosas que los humanos necesitan.** Cada palabra tiene peso.

segments.src: *Deliberate* separates it from foraging.
segments.tr: *Deliberada* la separa de la búsqueda de alimentos.

segments.src: *Biological systems* means you're working with organisms that grow, reproduce, get sick, and die on their own schedule.
segments.tr: *Sistemas biológicos* significa que estás trabajando con organismos que crecen, se reproducen, se enferman y mueren según su propio cronograma.

segments.src: *Manage* means you don't control them — you nudge them.
segments.tr: *Gestionar* significa que no los controlas — los empujas.

segments.src: That last point is the whole reason agriculture became a science instead of a craft.
segments.tr: Ese último punto es toda la razón por la que la agricultura se convirtió en una ciencia en lugar de un oficio.

segments.src: A civil engineer specifying a steel beam knows the yield strength.
segments.tr: Un ingeniero civil que especifica una viga de acero conoce la resistencia de cedencia.

segments.src: A farmer planting corn is negotiating with weather, soil chemistry, insect populations, and a genome — none of which sends a spec sheet.
segments.tr: Un granjero plantando maíz está negociando con el clima, la química del suelo, las poblaciones de insectos y un genoma — ninguno de los cuales envía una hoja de especificaciones.

segments.src: **A quick history, in four moves:**
segments.tr: **Una historia rápida, en cuatro movimientos:**

segments.src: 1. **Domestication (~10,000 BCE).** Humans in several regions independently began selecting and replanting favorable seeds. This wasn't invention so much as a slow feedback loop. Wheat and barley in the Fertile Crescent, rice in China, maize in Mesoamerica, potatoes in the Andes. Surplus food made cities possible.
segments.tr: 1. **Domesticación (~10.000 a.C.).** Los humanos en varias regiones comenzaron de forma independiente a seleccionar y replantar semillas favorables. Esto no fue tanto una invención como un bucle de retroalimentación lento. Trigo y cebada en el Creciente Fértil, arroz en China, maíz en Mesoamérica, papas en los Andes. El alimento excedente hizo que las ciudades fueran posibles.

segments.src: 2. **The agricultural revolutions (1700s–1800s).** Crop rotation replaced leaving fields fallow. Mechanical seed drills replaced broadcasting by hand. Justus von Liebig showed in the 1840s that plants take up mineral nutrients — turning soil fertility from folklore into chemistry.
segments.tr: 2. **Las revoluciones agrícolas (1700s–1800s).** La rotación de cultivos reemplazó dejar los campos en barbecho. Las sembradores mecánicas reemplazaron la siembra a mano. Justus von Liebig demostró en los años 1840 que las plantas absorben nutrientes minerales — convirtiendo la fertilidad del suelo de la tradición popular en química.

segments.src: 3. **The synthetic era (1900s).** The Haber-Bosch process (1909–1913) pulled nitrogen out of the air to make fertilizer. Gregor Mendel's rediscovered genetics enabled systematic breeding. Hybrid corn, then the Green Revolution of the 1950s–60s, roughly tripled cereal yields in much of the world.
segments.tr: 3. **La era sintética (1900s).** El proceso de Haber-Bosch (1909–1913) extrajo nitrógeno del aire para hacer fertilizante. La genética redescubierta de Gregor Mendel permitió la cría sistemática. El maíz híbrido, luego la Revolución Verde de los años 1950–60, aproximadamente triplicó los rendimientos de cereales en gran parte del mundo.

segments.src: 4. **The information era (now).** GPS-guided tractors, soil sensors, satellite imagery, genomic selection, and CRISPR gene editing. The bottleneck shifted from muscle to data.
segments.tr: 4. **La era de la información (ahora).** Tractores guiados por GPS, sensores de suelo, imágenes de satélite, selección genómica y edición de genes CRISPR. El cuello de botella cambió de músculo a datos.

segments.src: **What's actually inside the field.** "Agriculture" in a university catalog usually splits roughly like this:
segments.tr: **Lo que realmente hay dentro del campo.** "Agricultura" en un catálogo universitario generalmente se divide aproximadamente así:

segments.src: - **Crop science / agronomy** — field crops, physiology, cropping systems
segments.tr: - **Ciencia de cultivos / agronomía** — cultivos de campo, fisiología, sistemas de cultivo

segments.src: - **Horticulture** — fruits, vegetables, ornamentals, controlled environments
segments.tr: - **Horticultura** — frutas, verduras, ornamentales, ambientes controlados

segments.src: - **Soil science** — soil physics, chemistry, biology, fertility
segments.tr: - **Ciencia del suelo** — física del suelo, química, biología, fertilidad

segments.src: - **Animal science** — livestock nutrition, breeding, health, welfare
segments.tr: - **Ciencia animal** — nutrición del ganado, cría, salud, bienestar

segments.src: - **Plant protection** — entomology, plant pathology, weed science
segments.tr: - **Protección de plantas** — entomología, fitopatología, ciencia de malezas

segments.src: - **Agricultural engineering** — machinery, irrigation, structures, automation
segments.tr: - **Ingeniería agrícola** — maquinaria, riego, estructuras, automatización

segments.src: - **Agricultural economics** — markets, policy, farm management
segments.tr: - **Economía agrícola** — mercados, política, gestión agrícola

segments.src: - **Food science / post-harvest** — storage, processing, safety
segments.tr: - **Ciencia de alimentos / post-cosecha** — almacenamiento, procesamiento, seguridad

segments.src: - **Genetics and breeding** — cuts across nearly all of the above
segments.tr: - **Genética y cría** — atraviesa casi todo lo anterior

segments.src: Notice that this list spans chemistry, biology, mechanical engineering, statistics, and economics.
segments.tr: Observa que esta lista abarca química, biología, ingeniería mecánica, estadística y economía.

segments.src: Agriculture isn't a subfield of biology.
segments.tr: La agricultura no es un subcampo de la biología.

segments.src: It's an **integrative discipline** that pulls whatever it needs from the basic sciences and is judged by one question: did the system work in a real field, in a real season?
segments.tr: Es una **disciplina integrativa** que toma lo que necesita de las ciencias básicas y se juzga por una pregunta: ¿funcionó el sistema en un campo real, en una temporada real?

segments.tr: Esa ganancia de productividad es una de las más grandes en cualquier sector de la economía — y provino casi en su totalidad de la investigación.

segments.src: But modern agriculture also has a bill attached.
segments.tr: Pero la agricultura moderna también tiene un costo.

segments.src: It uses about 70% of global freshwater withdrawals and generates a meaningful share of greenhouse gas emissions.

segments.src: Fertilizer runoff from the Corn Belt flows down the Mississippi and drives a low-oxygen "dead zone" in the Gulf of Mexico that has averaged in the range of 5,000 square miles in recent years.
segments.tr: La escorrentía de fertilizantes del Cinturón de Maíz fluye por el Misisipi e impulsa una "zona muerta" con bajo oxígeno en el Golfo de México que ha promediado en el rango de 5.000 millas cuadradas en años recientes.

segments.src: So the modern research agenda isn't just *more yield* — it's yield per unit of water, per unit of nitrogen, per unit of emissions.
segments.tr: Entonces la agenda de investigación moderna no es solo *mayor rendimiento* — es rendimiento por unidad de agua, por unidad de nitrógeno, por unidad de emisiones.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## En la vida cotidiana

segments.src: Look at the price of a box of cereal at a Kroger in Ohio — say $4.99.

segments.src: The rest is processing, packaging, transport, retail margin, and labor.
segments.tr: El resto es procesamiento, empaque, transporte, margen minorista y mano de obra.

segments.src: ## Three-Line Summary
segments.tr: ## Resumen de tres líneas

segments.src: 1. Agriculture is the deliberate management of biological systems — plants, animals, soil, microbes — to produce food, fiber, and fuel, and it's a science because those systems can be steered but never fully controlled.
segments.tr: 1. La agricultura es la gestión deliberada de sistemas biológicos — plantas, animales, suelo, microbios — para producir alimentos, fibras y combustible, y es una ciencia porque esos sistemas pueden ser dirigidos pero nunca controlados completamente.

segments.src: 2. It advanced in four broad phases: domestication, the crop-rotation and mechanization revolutions, the synthetic-input and breeding era, and today's data-driven precision era.
segments.tr: 2. Avanzó en cuatro fases amplias: domesticación, las revoluciones de rotación de cultivos y mecanización, la era de insumos sintéticos y cría, y la era de precisión impulsada por datos de hoy.

segments.src: 3. It's an integrative discipline spanning agronomy, horticulture, soil science, animal science, engineering, and economics — now measured not only by yield but by yield per unit of water, nitrogen, and emissions.
segments.tr: 3. Es una disciplina integrativa que abarca agronomía, horticultura, ciencia del suelo, ciencia animal, ingeniería y economía — ahora medida no solo por rendimiento sino por rendimiento por unidad de agua, nitrógeno y emisiones.

segments.src: 1. **Domestication (~10,000 BCE).** Humans in several regions independently began selecting and replanting favorable seeds. This wasn't invention so much as a slow feedback loop. Wheat and barley in the Fertile Crescent, rice in China, maize in Mesoamerica, potatoes in the Andes. Surplus food made cities possible.
segments.tr: 1. **الاستئناس (~10,000 قبل الميلاد).** بدأ الإنسان في عدة مناطق بشكل مستقل باختيار وإعادة زراعة البذور المفضلة. لم تكن هذه اختراعاً بقدر ما كانت حلقة ردود فعل بطيئة. القمح والشعير في بلاد الشام، والأرز في الصين، والذرة في أمريكا الوسطى، والبطاطس في جبال الأنديز. الغذاء الفائض جعل المدن ممكنة.

segments.src: 2. **The agricultural revolutions (1700s–1800s).** Crop rotation replaced leaving fields fallow. Mechanical seed drills replaced broadcasting by hand. Justus von Liebig showed in the 1840s that plants take up mineral nutrients — turning soil fertility from folklore into chemistry.
segments.tr: 2. **الثورات الزراعية (1700–1800).** حل تناوب المحاصيل محل ترك الحقول بور. حلت المعدات الميكانيكية لنثر البذور محل النثر بالأيدي. أظهر جوستوس فون ليبج في أربعينيات القرن التاسع عشر أن النباتات تمتص العناصر المعدنية — مما حول خصوبة التربة من الفولكلور إلى الكيمياء.

segments.src: 3. **The synthetic era (1900s).** The Haber-Bosch process (1909–1913) pulled nitrogen out of the air to make fertilizer. Gregor Mendel's rediscovered genetics enabled systematic breeding. Hybrid corn, then the Green Revolution of the 1950s–60s, roughly tripled cereal yields in much of the world.
segments.tr: 3. **عصر المركبات الاصطناعية (1900).** استخرجت عملية هابر-بوش (1909–1913) النيتروجين من الهواء لصنع السماد. أتاحت الوراثة المكتشفة لجريجور مندل التحسين الوراثي المنهجي. ذرة هجينة، ثم الثورة الخضراء في الخمسينيات والستينيات، ثلثت تقريباً عوائل الحبوب في معظم أنحاء العالم.

segments.src: 4. **The information era (now).** GPS-guided tractors, soil sensors, satellite imagery, genomic selection, and CRISPR gene editing. The bottleneck shifted from muscle to data.
segments.tr: 4. **عصر المعلومات (الآن).** جرارات موجهة بالـGPS، ومستشعرات التربة، والصور الفضائية، والاختيار الجيني، وتحرير جينات CRISPR. انتقل الاختناق من العضلات إلى البيانات.

segments.src: ## Three-Line Summary
segments.tr: ## ملخص ثلاث أسطر

segments.src: 1. Agriculture is the deliberate management of biological systems — plants, animals, soil, microbes — to produce food, fiber, and fuel, and it's a science because those systems can be steered but never fully controlled.
segments.tr: 1. الزراعة هي الإدارة المقصودة للأنظمة البيولوجية — النباتات والحيوانات والتربة والميكروبات — لإنتاج الغذاء والألياف والوقود، وهي علم لأن تلك الأنظمة يمكن توجيهها لكن لا يمكن السيطرة عليها بالكامل.

segments.src: 2. It advanced in four broad phases: domestication, the crop-rotation and mechanization revolutions, the synthetic-input and breeding era, and today's data-driven precision era.
segments.tr: 2. تقدمت في أربع مراحل واسعة: الاستئناس، ثورات تناوب المحاصيل والميكنة، عصر المدخلات الاصطناعية والتحسين الوراثي، وعصر الدقة المدفوع بالبيانات اليوم.

segments.src: 3. It's an integrative discipline spanning agronomy, horticulture, soil science, animal science, engineering, and economics — now measured not only by yield but by yield per unit of water, nitrogen, and emissions.
segments.tr: 3. إنها تخصص متكامل يمتد عبر علم الزراعة والبستنة وعلم التربة وعلم الثروة الحيوانية والهندسة والاقتصاد — تقاس الآن ليس فقط بالعائد ولكن بالعائد لكل وحدة ماء ونيتروجين وانبعاثات.

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 مصطلحات اليوم

segments.src: - **Agronomy** — The science of field crop production and soil management, focused on large-scale staples like corn, wheat, and soybeans.
segments.tr: - **علم الزراعة** — علم إنتاج المحاصيل الحقلية وإدارة التربة، مع التركيز على المحاصيل الأساسية واسعة النطاق مثل الذرة والقمح وفول الصويا.

segments.src: - **Horticulture** — The science of intensively cultivated plants: fruits, vegetables, ornamentals, and greenhouse or controlled-environment crops.
segments.tr: - **البستنة** — علم النباتات المزروعة بكثافة: الفواكه والخضروات والنباتات الزينة والمحاصيل الدفيئة أو المحاصيل ذات البيئة المتحكم بها.

segments.src: - **Domestication** — The long process by which humans selectively bred wild species into forms dependent on and suited to cultivation.
segments.tr: - **الاستئناس** — العملية الطويلة التي قام بها الإنسان بتحسين السلالات البرية بشكل انتقائي إلى أشكال تعتمد على الزراعة وتناسبها.

segments.src: - **Green Revolution** — The mid-20th-century package of high-yielding dwarf varieties, fertilizer, irrigation, and pest control that sharply raised cereal yields, especially in Asia and Latin America.
segments.tr: - **الثورة الخضراء** — حزمة منتصف القرن العشرين من الأصناف القزمة عالية الإنتاجية والسماد والري ومكافحة الآفات التي رفعت عوائل الحبوب بشكل حاد، خاصة في آسيا وأمريكا اللاتينية.

segments.src: - **Precision agriculture** — Managing within-field variability using GPS, sensors, and data analytics to apply inputs at the right rate, place, and time.
segments.tr: - **الزراعة الدقيقة** — إدارة التباين داخل الحقل باستخدام GPS والمستشعرات وتحليلات البيانات لتطبيق المدخلات بالمعدل والمكان والوقت المناسب.

segments.src: > Agriculture is the applied science of managing living systems — plants, animals, soil, and microbes — to produce food, fiber, and fuel, and today it borrows as much from data science as from botany.
segments.tr: > L'agriculture est la science appliquée de la gestion des systèmes vivants — plantes, animaux, sols et microbes — pour produire de la nourriture, des fibres et du carburant, et aujourd'hui elle emprunte autant à la science des données qu'à la botanique.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## Le Concept d'Aujourd'hui

segments.src: Most people picture agriculture as a job.
segments.tr: La plupart des gens imaginent l'agriculture comme un métier.

segments.src: Academically, it's a **discipline** — one of the oldest organized bodies of applied knowledge we have.
segments.tr: Académiquement, c'est une **discipline** — l'une des plus anciennes organisations de connaissance appliquée que nous ayons.

segments.src: Here's the shortest useful definition: **agriculture is the deliberate management of biological systems to produce things humans need.** Every word carries weight.
segments.tr: Voici la définition la plus courte et utile: **l'agriculture est la gestion délibérée des systèmes biologiques pour produire ce dont les humains ont besoin.** Chaque mot a du poids.

segments.src: *Deliberate* separates it from foraging.
segments.tr: *Délibérée* la distingue de la récolte sauvage.

segments.src: *Biological systems* means you're working with organisms that grow, reproduce, get sick, and die on their own schedule.
segments.tr: *Systèmes biologiques* signifie que vous travaillez avec des organismes qui croissent, se reproduisent, tombent malades et meurent selon leur propre calendrier.

segments.src: *Manage* means you don't control them — you nudge them.
segments.tr: *Gérer* signifie que vous ne les contrôlez pas — vous les orientez.

segments.src: That last point is the whole reason agriculture became a science instead of a craft.
segments.tr: C'est ce dernier point qui est toute la raison pour laquelle l'agriculture est devenue une science plutôt qu'un art.

segments.src: A civil engineer specifying a steel beam knows the yield strength.
segments.tr: Un ingénieur civil spécifiant une poutre d'acier connaît la limite d'élasticité.

segments.src: A farmer planting corn is negotiating with weather, soil chemistry, insect populations, and a genome — none of which sends a spec sheet.
segments.tr: Un agriculteur plantant du maïs négocie avec la météo, la chimie du sol, les populations d'insectes et un génome — aucun ne lui envoie une fiche technique.

segments.src: **A quick history, in four moves:**
segments.tr: **Un bref historique, en quatre mouvements:**

segments.src: 1. **Domestication (~10,000 BCE).** Humans in several regions independently began selecting and replanting favorable seeds. This wasn't invention so much as a slow feedback loop. Wheat and barley in the Fertile Crescent, rice in China, maize in Mesoamerica, potatoes in the Andes. Surplus food made cities possible.
segments.tr: 1. **Domestication (~10 000 avant notre ère).** Les humains dans plusieurs régions ont commencé indépendamment à sélectionner et replanter des semences favorables. Ce n'était pas tant une invention qu'une lente boucle de rétroaction. Blé et orge dans le Croissant fertile, riz en Chine, maïs en Mésoamérique, pommes de terre dans les Andes. Les excédents alimentaires ont rendu les villes possibles.

segments.src: 2. **The agricultural revolutions (1700s–1800s).** Crop rotation replaced leaving fields fallow. Mechanical seed drills replaced broadcasting by hand. Justus von Liebig showed in the 1840s that plants take up mineral nutrients — turning soil fertility from folklore into chemistry.
segments.tr: 2. **Les révolutions agricoles (années 1700-1800).** La rotation des cultures a remplacé la jachère. Les semoirs mécaniques ont remplacé le semis à la main. Justus von Liebig a montré dans les années 1840 que les plantes absorbent les nutriments minéraux — transformant la fertilité du sol de la tradition en chimie.

segments.src: 3. **The synthetic era (1900s).** The Haber-Bosch process (1909–1913) pulled nitrogen out of the air to make fertilizer. Gregor Mendel's rediscovered genetics enabled systematic breeding. Hybrid corn, then the Green Revolution of the 1950s–60s, roughly tripled cereal yields in much of the world.
segments.tr: 3. **L'ère synthétique (années 1900).** Le procédé de Haber-Bosch (1909-1913) a tiré l'azote de l'air pour fabriquer de l'engrais. La génétique redécouverte de Gregor Mendel a permis l'amélioration systématique. Le maïs hybride, puis la Révolution verte des années 1950-1960, a grossièrement triplé les rendements céréaliers dans une grande partie du monde.

segments.src: 4. **The information era (now).** GPS-guided tractors, soil sensors, satellite imagery, genomic selection, and CRISPR gene editing. The bottleneck shifted from muscle to data.
segments.tr: 4. **L'ère de l'information (maintenant).** Tracteurs guidés par GPS, capteurs de sol, imagerie satellite, sélection génomique et édition génétique CRISPR. Le goulot d'étranglement s'est déplacé des muscles aux données.

pt.title: [Agricultura 101 #1] A Tecnologia Mais Antiga Que Você Usa Três Vezes por Dia

segments.src: > Agriculture is the applied science of managing living systems — plants, animals, soil, and microbes — to produce food, fiber, and fuel, and today it borrows as much from data science as from botany.
segments.tr: > Agricultura é a ciência aplicada de gerenciar sistemas vivos — plantas, animais, solo e microrganismos — para produzir alimento, fibra e combustível, e hoje ela toma tanto emprestado da ciência de dados quanto da botânica.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## Conceito de Hoje

segments.src: Most people picture agriculture as a job.
segments.tr: A maioria das pessoas imagina a agricultura como um trabalho.

segments.src: Academically, it's a **discipline** — one of the oldest organized bodies of applied knowledge we have.
segments.tr: Academicamente, é uma **disciplina** — um dos mais antigos corpos organizados de conhecimento aplicado que temos.

segments.src: Here's the shortest useful definition: **agriculture is the deliberate management of biological systems to produce things humans need.** Every word carries weight.
segments.tr: Aqui está a definição mais útil e breve: **agricultura é o gerenciamento deliberado de sistemas biológicos para produzir coisas que os humanos precisam.** Cada palavra tem peso.

segments.src: *Deliberate* separates it from foraging.
segments.tr: *Deliberado* a separa da busca por alimento.

segments.src: *Biological systems* means you're working with organisms that grow, reproduce, get sick, and die on their own schedule.
segments.tr: *Sistemas biológicos* significa que você está trabalhando com organismos que crescem, se reproduzem, ficam doentes e morrem conforme seu próprio cronograma.

segments.src: *Manage* means you don't control them — you nudge them.
segments.tr: *Gerenciar* significa que você não os controla — você os orienta.

segments.src: That last point is the whole reason agriculture became a science instead of a craft.
segments.tr: Este último ponto é toda a razão pela qual a agricultura se tornou uma ciência em vez de um ofício.

segments.src: A civil engineer specifying a steel beam knows the yield strength.
segments.tr: Um engenheiro civil que especifica uma viga de aço conhece a resistência ao escoamento.

segments.src: A farmer planting corn is negotiating with weather, soil chemistry, insect populations, and a genome — none of which sends a spec sheet.
segments.tr: Um agricultor que planta milho está negociando com clima, química do solo, populações de insetos e um genoma — nenhum dos quais envia uma folha de especificações.

segments.src: **A quick history, in four moves:**
segments.tr: **Um histórico rápido, em quatro movimentos:**

segments.src: 1. **Domestication (~10,000 BCE).** Humans in several regions independently began selecting and replanting favorable seeds. This wasn't invention so much as a slow feedback loop. Wheat and barley in the Fertile Crescent, rice in China, maize in Mesoamerica, potatoes in the Andes. Surplus food made cities possible.
segments.tr: 1. **Domesticação (~10.000 AEC).** Humanos em várias regiões começaram independentemente a selecionar e replantar sementes favoráveis. Isso não foi tanto uma invenção quanto um lento ciclo de feedback. Trigo e cevada no Crescente Fértil, arroz na China, milho na Mesoamérica, batatas nos Andes. O excesso de alimento tornou as cidades possíveis.

segments.src: 2. **The agricultural revolutions (1700s–1800s).** Crop rotation replaced leaving fields fallow. Mechanical seed drills replaced broadcasting by hand. Justus von Liebig showed in the 1840s that plants take up mineral nutrients — turning soil fertility from folklore into chemistry.
segments.tr: 2. **As revoluções agrícolas (1700s–1800s).** A rotação de culturas substituiu deixar os campos em pousio. As semeadoras mecânicas substituíram o lançamento manual. Justus von Liebig mostrou na década de 1840 que as plantas absorvem nutrientes minerais — transformando a fertilidade do solo de folclore em química.

segments.src: 3. **The synthetic era (1900s).** The Haber-Bosch process (1909–1913) pulled nitrogen out of the air to make fertilizer. Gregor Mendel's rediscovered genetics enabled systematic breeding. Hybrid corn, then the Green Revolution of the 1950s–60s, roughly tripled cereal yields in much of the world.
segments.tr: 3. **A era sintética (1900s).** O processo de Haber-Bosch (1909–1913) extraiu nitrogênio do ar para fazer fertilizante. A genética redescoberta de Gregor Mendel permitiu o melhoramento sistemático. Milho híbrido, depois a Revolução Verde dos anos 1950–60, aproximadamente triplicou os rendimentos de cereais em grande parte do mundo.

segments.src: 4. **The information era (now).** GPS-guided tractors, soil sensors, satellite imagery, genomic selection, and CRISPR gene editing. The bottleneck shifted from muscle to data.
segments.tr: 4. **A era da informação (agora).** Tratores guiados por GPS, sensores de solo, imagens de satélite, seleção genômica e edição de genes CRISPR. O gargalo mudou de músculo para dados.

segments.tr: 2. Avançou em quatro fases amplas: domesticação, as revoluções de rotação de culturas e mecanização, a era de insumos sintéticos e melhoramento, e a era de precisão orientada por dados de hoje.

segments.tr: 3. É uma disciplina integrativa abrangendo agronomia, horticultura, ciência do solo, ciência animal, engenharia e economia — agora medida não apenas por rendimento, mas por rendimento por unidade de água, nitrogênio e emissões.

in.title: [Pertanian 101 #1] Teknologi Tertua yang Anda Gunakan Tiga Kali Sehari

segments.src: > Agriculture is the applied science of managing living systems — plants, animals, soil, and microbes — to produce food, fiber, and fuel, and today it borrows as much from data science as from botany.
segments.tr: > Pertanian adalah sains terapan untuk mengelola sistem biologis — tanaman, hewan, tanah, dan mikroba — guna menghasilkan pangan, serat, dan bahan bakar, dan saat ini ia meminjam sebanyak dari sains data seperti dari botani.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## Konsep Hari Ini

segments.src: Most people picture agriculture as a job.
segments.tr: Kebanyakan orang membayangkan pertanian sebagai sebuah pekerjaan.

segments.src: Academically, it's a **discipline** — one of the oldest organized bodies of applied knowledge we have.
segments.tr: Secara akademis, itu adalah **disiplin ilmu** — salah satu badan pengetahuan terapan terorganisir tertua yang kami miliki.

segments.src: Here's the shortest useful definition: **agriculture is the deliberate management of biological systems to produce things humans need.** Every word carries weight.
segments.tr: Ini adalah definisi paling singkat yang berguna: **pertanian adalah pengelolaan deliberat sistem biologi untuk menghasilkan hal-hal yang dibutuhkan manusia.** Setiap kata memiliki bobot.

segments.src: *Deliberate* separates it from foraging.
segments.tr: *Deliberat* membedakannya dari foraging.

segments.src: *Biological systems* means you're working with organisms that grow, reproduce, get sick, and die on their own schedule.
segments.tr: *Sistem biologi* berarti Anda bekerja dengan organisme yang tumbuh, berkembang biak, sakit, dan mati sesuai jadwal mereka sendiri.

segments.src: *Manage* means you don't control them — you nudge them.
segments.tr: *Mengelola* berarti Anda tidak mengendalikan mereka — Anda mendorong mereka.

segments.src: That last point is the whole reason agriculture became a science instead of a craft.
segments.tr: Poin terakhir itu adalah seluruh alasan pertanian menjadi sains bukan kerajinan.

segments.src: A civil engineer specifying a steel beam knows the yield strength.
segments.tr: Seorang insinyur sipil yang menentukan balok baja mengetahui kekuatan hasil.

segments.src: A farmer planting corn is negotiating with weather, soil chemistry, insect populations, and a genome — none of which sends a spec sheet.
segments.tr: Seorang petani menanam jagung sedang bernegosiasi dengan cuaca, kimia tanah, populasi serangga, dan genom — tidak satupun mengirim lembar spesifikasi.

segments.src: **A quick history, in four moves:**
segments.tr: **Sejarah singkat, dalam empat gerakan:**

segments.src: 1. **Domestication (~10,000 BCE).** Humans in several regions independently began selecting and replanting favorable seeds. This wasn't invention so much as a slow feedback loop. Wheat and barley in the Fertile Crescent, rice in China, maize in Mesoamerica, potatoes in the Andes. Surplus food made cities possible.
segments.tr: 1. **Domestikasi (~10.000 SM).** Manusia di beberapa wilayah secara independen mulai memilih dan menanam kembali benih yang menguntungkan. Ini bukan penemuan melainkan loop umpan balik yang lambat. Gandum dan jelai di Bulan Sabit Subur, beras di Cina, jagung di Mesoamerika, kentang di Andes. Surplus pangan membuat kota menjadi mungkin.

segments.src: 2. **The agricultural revolutions (1700s–1800s).** Crop rotation replaced leaving fields fallow. Mechanical seed drills replaced broadcasting by hand. Justus von Liebig showed in the 1840s that plants take up mineral nutrients — turning soil fertility from folklore into chemistry.
segments.tr: 2. **Revolusi pertanian (1700-an–1800-an).** Rotasi tanaman menggantikan membiarkan ladang bera. Mesin tanam mekanis menggantikan penyebaran tangan. Justus von Liebig menunjukkan pada tahun 1840-an bahwa tanaman menyerap nutrisi mineral — mengubah kesuburan tanah dari dongeng menjadi kimia.

segments.src: 3. **The synthetic era (1900s).** The Haber-Bosch process (1909–1913) pulled nitrogen out of the air to make fertilizer. Gregor Mendel's rediscovered genetics enabled systematic breeding. Hybrid corn, then the Green Revolution of the 1950s–60s, roughly tripled cereal yields in much of the world.
segments.tr: 3. **Era sintetis (1900-an).** Proses Haber-Bosch (1909–1913) menarik nitrogen dari udara untuk membuat pupuk. Genetika Gregor Mendel yang ditemukan kembali memungkinkan pemuliaan sistematis. Jagung hibrida, kemudian Revolusi Hijau tahun 1950-an–60-an, kurang lebih meningkatkan hasil sereal tiga kali lipat di banyak bagian dunia.

segments.src: 4. **The information era (now).** GPS-guided tractors, soil sensors, satellite imagery, genomic selection, and CRISPR gene editing. The bottleneck shifted from muscle to data.
segments.tr: 4. **Era informasi (sekarang).** Traktor berpandu GPS, sensor tanah, citra satelit, seleksi genomik, dan pengeditan gen CRISPR. Hambatan bergeser dari otot ke data.

segments.src: **What's actually inside the field.** "Agriculture" in a university catalog usually splits roughly like this:
segments.tr: **Yang sebenarnya ada di dalam lapangan.** "Pertanian" dalam katalog universitas biasanya terbagi kurang lebih seperti ini:

segments.src: - **Crop science / agronomy** — field crops, physiology, cropping systems
segments.tr: - **Ilmu tanaman / agronomi** — tanaman lapangan, fisiologi, sistem pertanian

segments.src: - **Horticulture** — fruits, vegetables, ornamentals, controlled environments
segments.tr: - **Hortikultura** — buah-buahan, sayuran, tanaman hias, lingkungan terkontrol

segments.src: - **Soil science** — soil physics, chemistry, biology, fertility
segments.tr: - **Ilmu tanah** — fisika tanah, kimia, biologi, kesuburan

segments.src: - **Animal science** — livestock nutrition, breeding, health, welfare
segments.tr: - **Ilmu ternak** — nutrisi ternak, pemuliaan, kesehatan, kesejahteraan

segments.src: - **Plant protection** — entomology, plant pathology, weed science
segments.tr: - **Perlindungan tanaman** — entomologi, patologi tanaman, sains gulma

segments.src: - **Agricultural engineering** — machinery, irrigation, structures, automation
segments.tr: - **Teknik pertanian** — mesin, irigasi, struktur, otomasi

segments.src: - **Agricultural economics** — markets, policy, farm management
segments.tr: - **Ekonomi pertanian** — pasar, kebijakan, manajemen pertanian

segments.src: - **Food science / post-harvest** — storage, processing, safety
segments.tr: - **Sains pangan / pasca-panen** — penyimpanan, pengolahan, keamanan

segments.src: - **Genetics and breeding** — cuts across nearly all of the above
segments.tr: - **Genetika dan pemuliaan** — memotong hampir semua di atas

segments.src: Notice that this list spans chemistry, biology, mechanical engineering, statistics, and economics.
segments.tr: Perhatikan bahwa daftar ini mencakup kimia, biologi, teknik mesin, statistik, dan ekonomi.

segments.src: Agriculture isn't a subfield of biology.
segments.tr: Pertanian bukan subfragmen biologi.

segments.src: It's an **integrative discipline** that pulls whatever it needs from the basic sciences and is judged by one question: did the system work in a real field, in a real season?
segments.tr: Ini adalah **disiplin integratif** yang mengambil apa pun yang dibutuhkan dari sains dasar dan dinilai oleh satu pertanyaan: apakah sistem bekerja di lapangan nyata, di musim nyata?

segments.src: **Why it still matters.** In 1900, roughly 40% of the U.S.
segments.tr: **Mengapa masih penting.** Pada tahun 1900, kurang lebih 40% dari angkatan kerja AS

segments.src: workforce farmed.
segments.tr: bercocok tanam.

segments.src: Today it's under 2%, and that 2% feeds the country with a large surplus for export.
segments.tr: Hari ini kurang dari 2%, dan 2% itu memberi makan negara dengan surplus besar untuk ekspor.

segments.src: That productivity gain is one of the largest in any sector of the economy — and it came almost entirely from research.
segments.tr: Keuntungan produktivitas itu adalah salah satu yang terbesar di sektor ekonomi manapun — dan itu berasal hampir sepenuhnya dari penelitian.

segments.src: But modern agriculture also has a bill attached.
segments.tr: Tetapi pertanian modern juga memiliki tagihan yang melekat.

segments.src: It uses about 70% of global freshwater withdrawals and generates a meaningful share of greenhouse gas emissions.
segments.tr: Ia menggunakan sekitar 70% dari penarikan air tawar global dan menghasilkan bagian yang berarti dari emisi gas rumah kaca.

segments.src: Fertilizer runoff from the Corn Belt flows down the Mississippi and drives a low-oxygen "dead zone" in the Gulf of Mexico that has averaged in the range of 5,000 square miles in recent years.
segments.tr: Limpasan pupuk dari Corn Belt mengalir ke Mississippi dan mendorong zona "mati" rendah oksigen di Teluk Meksiko yang rata-rata dalam kisaran 5.000 mil persegi dalam beberapa tahun terakhir.

segments.src: So the modern research agenda isn't just *more yield* — it's yield per unit of water, per unit of nitrogen, per unit of emissions.
segments.tr: Jadi agenda penelitian modern bukan hanya *hasil lebih banyak* — itu hasil per satuan air, per satuan nitrogen, per satuan emisi.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## Dalam Kehidupan Sehari-hari

segments.src: Look at the price of a box of cereal at a Kroger in Ohio — say $4.99.
segments.tr: Lihat harga sekotak sereal di Kroger di Ohio — katakan $4,99.

segments.src: Under the USDA's accounting, only around 15 cents of every retail food dollar goes back to the farm.
segments.tr: Di bawah akuntansi USDA, hanya sekitar 15 sen dari setiap dolar makanan ritel yang kembali ke pertanian.

segments.src: The rest is processing, packaging, transport, retail margin, and labor.
segments.tr: Sisanya adalah pengolahan, kemasan, pengangkutan, margin ritel, dan tenaga kerja.

segments.src: This is worth sitting with, because it reframes what agriculture *is*.
segments.tr: Ini layak direnungkan, karena itu mengubah kerangka apa itu pertanian.

segments.src: When a drought hits Kansas and wheat futures spike 30% in Chicago, your cereal box doesn't jump 30% — it might move a few percent.
segments.tr: Ketika kekeringan melanda Kansas dan kontrak berjangka gandum lonjakan 30% di Chicago, kotak sereal Anda tidak melompat 30% — itu mungkin bergerak beberapa persen.

segments.src: The farm is the base of a very tall stack.
segments.tr: Pertanian adalah dasar dari tumpukan yang sangat tinggi.

segments.src: Now flip it.
segments.tr: Sekarang balikkan.

segments.src: A California almond grower decides whether to irrigate based on a soil moisture probe reporting to their phone.
segments.tr: Seorang petani almond California memutuskan apakah akan mengairi berdasarkan probe kelembaban tanah yang melaporkan ke ponsel mereka.

segments.src: Their decision reflects Central Valley water allocations, the price of diesel, an export contract to India, and a labor market.
segments.tr: Keputusan mereka mencerminkan alokasi air Central Valley, harga diesel, kontrak ekspor ke India, dan pasar tenaga kerja.

segments.src: One irrigation call is simultaneously a biology problem, an engineering problem, and an economics problem.
segments.tr: Satu panggilan irigasi adalah secara bersamaan masalah biologi, masalah teknik, dan masalah ekonomi.

segments.src: That's the field in miniature.
segments.tr: Itulah lapangan dalam miniatur.

segments.src: When people say agriculture is "low-tech," they're usually looking at the picturesque parts — a barn, a field, a tractor at sunset.
segments.tr: Ketika orang mengatakan pertanian adalah "teknologi rendah," mereka biasanya melihat bagian-bagian yang indah — gudang, ladang, traktor saat matahari terbenam.

segments.src: The actual work is closer to running a distributed biological factory where the machinery grows, the inputs are weather-dependent, and you get roughly one production run per year to learn from.
segments.tr: Pekerjaan sebenarnya lebih dekat dengan menjalankan pabrik biologi terdistribusi di mana mesinerinya tumbuh, input bergantung pada cuaca, dan Anda mendapat kira-kira satu proses produksi per tahun untuk belajar.
